quotes.text: Instead of building one giant agent that knows everything, you now orchestrate multiple smaller ones that each know a focused slice
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the core design principle of modular multi-agent orchestration in one sentence.

quotes.text: Over delegation creates context dead zones where child agents lack the information needed to answer correctly. Solve that by defining clear parameters and passing relevant outputs.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names a concrete failure mode of agent delegation and how to fix it.

quotes.text: Treat those outputs like unreviewed pull requests. The AI may optimize for readability, but it doesn't yet optimize for compliance exceptions or data masking policies.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Practical governance advice for reviewing AI-generated app code.

quotes.text: Generative pages are starting points, not finish lines. Professionals who learn to articulate style, data, behavior, and accessibility inside their prompts will design better systems faster.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Frames generative UI as a prompt skill rather than a replacement for design work.

chapters.title: The AI revolution in Microsoft Power Platform
Dataverse prompt columns: data that reasons

takeaways: Dataverse prompt columns let a table field run a natural-language instruction, replacing brittle formula logic and many supporting flows.
Form fill assistance in model-driven apps turns pasted emails, text or screenshots into suggested Dataverse field values that users confirm before saving.
Copilot Studio's agents-calling-agents model splits one monolithic bot into a parent agent and focused child agents that are easier to test, debug and version.
hook: Still wiring up Power Fx formulas and manual flows while Power Platform quietly turns AI into a building block? This episode is for makers and architects who want to know what Dataverse prompt columns, form filler, generative pages and Copilot Studio agents actually change. You will learn where each tool fits, where it falls short, and how to start practicing in a sandbox today.
